name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: In Ashenvale, Raene Wolfrunner seeks a way to restore Dartol's ancient rod. A Glowing Gem has brought her to Shael'dryn, a dryad east of Iris Lake.

sections.title: A Clue in Teronis's Notes
sections.body: Raene Wolfrunner studies the field notes of Teronis, the sentinel who died investigating Ashenvale's troubled furbolgs. His work points to an ancient rod made by a night elf named Dartol. Raene has found a Glowing Gem, yet her skill as a huntress cannot explain the relic's arcane and natural mysteries.

sections.title: Seeking the Daughters of Cenarius
sections.body: Raene sends you northeast toward Iris Lake to find Shael'dryn, a dryad who lives beside a moonwell. As one of the Daughters of Cenarius, Shael'dryn understands the forest and its ancient relics. Bring her the Glowing Gem, and she may tell you what else is needed to restore Dartol's Rod.

faq.answer: Teronis was a night elf scout sent by Astranaar to investigate the corruption spreading through Ashenvale. He died on that mission, but his journal offered a clue: restoring Dartol's Rod might help the land.
Dartol's Rod is an ancient magical artifact Raene Wolfrunner hopes will aid her investigation of Ashenvale's furbolgs. The Glowing Gem she recovered is one piece needed to restore it.
Shael'dryn lives beside a secluded moonwell northeast of Astranaar, in the hills just east of Iris Lake. Follow the road east, then turn north before the dangerous lands near Raynewood Retreat.
The Glowing Gem is one piece of Dartol's Rod, recovered from the ruins where Teronis investigated. Shael'dryn needs it to discover what other pieces the rod requires.

faq.q: Why does Raene Wolfrunner send you to a dryad?
faq.answer: Raene Wolfrunner is a huntress and leader of Astranaar's sentinels, intent on defending the town. Dryads, the Daughters of Cenarius, understand ancient relics and the restoration of nature.

faq.q: Why is the forest around Iris Lake in danger?
faq.answer: Corruption and unrest are spreading among Ashenvale's wildlife and furbolg tribes. Raene hopes restoring the rod will help her understand the furbolgs' plight.

angles.text: Restoring the rod carries on Teronis's unfinished investigation into the troubles of Ashenvale's furbolgs.
As a druid, helping Shael'dryn serves your Cenarion duty to mend the broken bonds between nature and Kaldorei magic.
As an Alliance member, helping secure ancient artifacts and strengthen Astranaar's northern perimeter supports the war effort against growing threats in the region.
